body: Ball bearings → broking with brother. 1992 short vs Harshad Mehta (BPL, Videocon, Sterlite). Long holds: HDFC Bank IPO, VST, Crisil, 3M, India Cements. D-Mart 2002 (EDLP ~8% below market, owned stores, pay suppliers ~10 days); slow expansion. ~90% wealth = D-Mart stake at 2017 IPO. Forbes 2026 $13.7–15.7bn. 'Bear cartel'/'week from bankruptcy' unsourced. No SEBI order found.
title: Radhakishan Damani
